statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once and put d_T=6-r_T for each actual triangle. Suppose R=226, every d_T belongs to {0,1,2,3}, exactly two actual triangles have deficiency three, and exactly two have deficiency two. Then the two deficiency-three triangles are disjoint.
assumptions: R=226 counts actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once
d_T=6-r_T belongs to {0,1,2,3} for every actual triangle
exactly two actual triangles have deficiency three
exactly two actual triangles have deficiency two

scope.description: Conditional rejection of the valid but collapsed common-point graph in the c2/b2 R226/maxd3 lane.

limitations: The local(3,3,2,2) graph is valid; it is rejected only by complete target cycle incidence.
The collapsed local cycle is counted explicitly and no faithful square/F4 assumption is used.
The disjoint b2/c2 case and the rest of R226 remain unresolved by this statement.
No automorphism, equitability, selected inducedness, numerical infeasibility or target resolution is claimed.
